description: Caption schema for race flags. Output by Gemini using Tools/captioning/prompts/flag_prompt.md.

field_descriptions.geometry: Shapes, divisions, dominant motifs of the flag (bands, quadrants, central emblems).
field_descriptions.color_palette: Primary, secondary, and accent colours. Include hex if extractable.
field_descriptions.symbolism: What the marks/icons evoke (sun, sword, ouroboros, geometric abstraction).
field_descriptions.cultural_hints: What kind of society would adopt this flag (martial, mercantile, religious, etc.).
field_descriptions.mood: Single overall mood from the enum.
field_descriptions.distinctive_traits: Anything unusual or memorable that doesn't fit the other fields.
